en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a mountain village scene. In the foreground stands a three-story hotel building with the words "ALBERGO CENTRALE" on its facade. The structure is set at a road junction, with trees and smaller buildings around it. In the background are forested hills and cultivated fields typical of an Alpine valley. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as S. Orsola at 950 meters above sea level and describes it as a bathing/health resort.
